name: Repair ASAP LLC
description: Repair ASAP LLC is a licensed and insured NYC handyman service for repairs, installations, furniture assembly, TV mounting, appliance installation, painting, flooring, AC installation and cleaning, minor plumbing fixture work, electrical fixture/device replacement, and new apartment setup.
highIntentServiceRequests: Washer, dryer, refrigerator, microwave, and range installation
Accessible shut-off valve replacement, visible leak repair, and bathroom fixture installation
Ceiling fan, chandelier, light fixture, outlet, switch, USB outlet, smart device setup, and electrical troubleshooting for fixture/device symptoms when existing wiring and building rules fit
Window AC installation, AC bracket installation, through-wall AC installation, PTAC installation, portable AC setup, AC removal, and AC deep cleaning
TV mounting, over-fireplace TV mounting, wire concealment, shelf installation, curtain rod installation, mirror mounting, art hanging, and wall cabinet installation
New apartment setup and COI-ready co-op/condo punch-list work
Interior painting, drywall repair, decorative plaster, Tadelakt-style finishes, lime plaster, Venetian plaster, and accent wall work
priorityMarkets: Nassau County where scope and travel fit

booking.instructions: Call or text photos, location, timing, and building requirements for a quote before work begins.

quotePreparationByCategory.applianceInstallation: Send the appliance model number, installation space photo, existing hookups, delivery status, and building or COI requirements.
quotePreparationByCategory.plumbingFixtures: Send photos of the fixture, shut-off valves or under-sink area, new model if available, leak or damage area, cabinet/countertop access, and building or COI requirements.
quotePreparationByCategory.electricalFixtures: Send photos of the current fixture, outlet, switch, thermostat, doorbell, lock, or fan box, the new product model, fixture weight if relevant, ceiling or wall type, box depth/support, WiFi/app requirements for smart devices, and building rules.
quotePreparationByCategory.tvAndWallMounting: Send a wall photo, item size and weight, mount or hardware details, desired placement, and wall type.
quotePreparationByCategory.acInstallation: Send the AC model or BTU label, window or sleeve photos, measurements, bracket requirements, and building or COI rules.
quotePreparationByCategory.paintingAndWallFinishes: Send room photos, wall dimensions, finish references, paint or material details, moisture concerns, and access requirements.
quotePreparationByCategory.furnitureAssembly: Send the product link or model, box count, room photo, delivery status, room access, and whether wall anchoring, anti-tip restraints, ceiling clearance, packaging removal, or COI paperwork is required.
quotePreparationByCategory.generalRepairs: Send clear photos, measurements, product links if parts are involved, timing, and building access requirements.

regulatedTradeScope.electrical: NYC electrical work involving new wiring routes, added circuits, service equipment, new outlet or fixture locations, 220V/240V outlets, EV chargers, or permit-level electrical installations may require a NYC Licensed Master Electrician and DOB permit. Repair ASAP reviews photos and scope before booking fixture/device replacement, setup, and troubleshooting work.
regulatedTradeScope.plumbing: NYC plumbing work involving piping systems, gas piping, permit-level alterations, or non-cosmetic plumbing scope may require a Licensed Master Plumber and DOB permit. Repair ASAP reviews photos and scope before booking plumbing fixture work.
regulatedTradeScope.gasAppliances: Gas appliance or gas piping scope is reviewed before booking. Code-ready appliance setup may still require Licensed Master Plumber/DOB handling depending on the building and work requested.

trustSignals: COI support for NYC co-ops and condos
